interpretation: Reference-inspired creative designs, not measured manufacturer or film-stock replicas. Lab adjustments are design choices.

pentax_gold.label: 宾得 Gold · 蓝影金光
pentax_gold.intent: Blue shadows, neutral middle greys and clearly yellow highlights; no magenta wash.

pentax_satobi.label: 宾得 Satobi · 青蓝暗黄褪红
pentax_satobi.intent: Cyan blue, dull yellow and faded red; deliberately different from a warm overall tint.

pentax_reversal.label: 宾得 Reversal · 深黑正片
pentax_reversal.intent: Deep tonal separation with warm foliage and strong colour; neutral highlights.

fuji_classicchrome.label: 富士 Classic Chrome · 冷影纪实
fuji_classicchrome.intent: Muted colour, substantial shadows, olive greens, cyan blues and suppressed magenta.

fuji_velvia50.label: 富士 Velvia · 浓绿深蓝
fuji_velvia50.intent: Strong contrast, emerald foliage and saturated skies with restrained orange skin.

fuji_eterna.label: 富士 Eterna · 柔光电影
fuji_eterna.intent: Open shadows, compressed highlights and low colour density; not a high-contrast teal filter.

fuji_superia400.label: 富士 Superia · 青绿负片
fuji_superia400.intent: Creative interpretation with cyan-green shadows, lively red and warm restrained highlights.

kodak_portra400.label: 柯达 Portra · 柔肤暖绿
kodak_portra400.intent: Soft skin, restrained foliage, broad highlight roll-off and slight warmth; neutral whites.

kodak_gold200.label: 柯达 Gold · 暖黄日常
kodak_gold200.intent: Warm yellow middle tones and foliage, muted blue; unlike Pentax Gold, shadows are not blue.

kodak_ektar100.label: 柯达 Ektar · 鲜明彩色
kodak_ektar100.intent: Vivid red/yellow and clean blue; moderate-to-strong contrast without a coloured white point.

kodak_kchrome64.label: Kodachrome · 砖红深蓝
kodak_kchrome64.intent: Creative reference: tight blacks, warm red/ochre, subdued olive green and deep blue.

ricoh_positive.label: 理光 Positive · 浓郁正片
ricoh_positive.intent: Dense, distinct red/green/blue with orange skin protected from global saturation.

ricoh_negative.label: 理光 Negative · 褪色清彩
ricoh_negative.intent: Faded tonal base with readable colour edges, cyan foliage and red leaning toward orange.

ricoh_bleach.label: 理光 Bleach · 低彩硬调
ricoh_bleach.intent: Strong tonal contrast with low saturation and cool, nearly neutral shadows.

canon_portrait.label: 佳能 Portrait · 明亮柔肤
canon_portrait.intent: Bright skin and relatively lively surrounding blue/green, with skin-only mild rosy colour.

canon_landscape.label: 佳能 Landscape · 蓝绿通透
canon_landscape.intent: Clear vivid blue and green with clean whites and less severe shadows than a reversal look.

polaroid600.label: Polaroid 600 · 奶油相纸
polaroid600.source: creative print interpretation; not a calibrated film replica
polaroid600.intent: Visible lifted black, gentle colour, soft paper white and creamy warm highlights.

ilford_hp5.label: Ilford HP5 · 银盐黑白
ilford_hp5.intent: Neutral monochrome with substantial midtone separation and open shadow detail; grain is not simulated.
